_comment: Out-of-sample federal-EITC-by-state cross-check: the microcosm weighted total of the federal eitc variable over each state's households vs IRS EITC Central administrative totals for TY2024. These are NOT calibration targets (EITC is calibrated nationally, not per state). Because ~20 state EITCs are flat matches on the federal credit, this geography is the mechanical driver of the state-program suite; scoring it separately isolates federal-geography error from state-rule error. IRS rounding: 2-3 significant figures on large states.

levels.name: Federal EITC claimed in New York

benchmark.source: IRS EITC Central, Statistics for tax returns with EITC, TY2024 (as of Dec 2025) — New York total EITC; IRS rounds large states to 2-3 significant figures

levels.description: Weighted federal EITC total for New York households vs IRS TY2024 administrative claims. Validates the geographic distribution of the federal EITC independently of any state report — the state match-rate credits inherit this geography mechanically. National EITC is calibrated to an earlier SOI vintage, so a uniform few-percent undershoot vs TY2024 is expected; state-specific deviations beyond that are geographic error.
